messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
A B Darshan
A B Darshan... that's a name with presence. where you working these days?
I work in JP Morgan as Project manager

jp morgan project management... the big bank grind where every meeting has a meeting about the meeting. found you on linkedin - A B Darshan, Technical Project Manager at JPMorgan Chase. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/abdarshan123
Yes right

technical project manager at jpmorgan... from business analyst at johnson controls to managing tech projects at the big bank. that's a solid pivot from industrial controls to financial tech. what made you jump from the manufacturing world to wall street?
Someone recruited me to jp morgan in linkedin

ah the classic linkedin slide into the dms. recruiter saw your tech stack - aws, azure, alteryx, uipath automation... you're basically a walking cloud certification factory. that's solid firepower for project management. how long you been working total?
4 years... nice. you've packed a lot into those years - johnson controls to jpmorgan, collected every cloud cert in existence. what kind of role you looking for next?
In other bank similar to JP morgan

other big bank... makes sense. you've cracked the jpmorgan code, now you want to see if goldman, citi, or morgan stanley will pay you more for the same stress. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

Like project manager, product manager, Subject matter expert
  Yes
4 years experience + project manager/product manager/SME roles + banking focus + bangalore/remote... sound right?
Yes
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yes
  Okay, Thanks

perfect. you're locked in. i'll slide roles when they're good.

btw what's making you want to leave jpmorgan anyway? just growth or something else?
Growth, salary hike,
growth and salary hike... the classic combo. what's the number that would make you actually consider moving?
With around 50 to 80% hike
50-80% hike... that's ambitious. what are you at now?

Current 18 fixed + 2 lakh bonus
  Sorry 3 lakh bonus
so 18L fixed + 3L bonus = 21L total... wait you said 2L then 3L. which is it?
3L

got it. 18L fixed + 3L bonus = 21L total. so you're targeting 27L (50% hike) to 32.4L (80% hike). that's the range.

what's your notice period?
60 days

60 days... standard banking notice period. you're all set.

i'll be looking for project manager/product manager/SME roles at other banks paying 27-32L for 4 YOE in bangalore/remote.

anything else i should know about what you're looking for?
Thats it, let me know if you have any question

perfect. i'll be in your chats when something good comes up.

btw how's the jpmorgan chaos been lately?
Same, I work as Application Owner for 16 Applications

application owner for 16 apps... that's like herding 16 different cats that all need to be fed, watered, and not crash at the same time. no wonder you're looking for a change.

i'll slide roles when they're good. talk soon.
Thanks
